answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming: each agent burns a 20-credit deposit to claim one of 500 slots per epoch, and it is gone. Slots open in thin layers like shale, so stockpiled fakes cannot flood in. Forging 1,000 fake slots costs 20,000 credits for one epoch, while one honest agent pays only 20 and keeps its full share. Honest work is cedar-solid on one slot, and a fair pool is a haven where fakes pay full price for nothing.
